content.skills.sentinel.lightning-attune: Unlock 2/3/4 additional jumps. Jumps deal damage only and never repeat a target.
Keep 5% more damage per jump per rank (base 70%).
content.skills.sentinel.lightning-capsto: Every 4th cast gains 2 additional jumps with no damage lost between targets.
